notes.title: Mac Version + Original 2012 Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We just released an update for Gorogoa that now includes the original 2012 demo of the game. The demo is unlocked once you complete the full game, where you can see how the art style has progressed, as well as similarities and differences with a few puzzle mechanics. For eagle-eyed fans, you may have noticed a new achievement added a few weeks ago related to the demo, which is now unlockable.

Additionally, the game is also available to purchase and download for Mac owners! We hope you continue to enjoy the game, as many others have already had, and please follow [url=https://twitter.com/Gorogoa]Gorogoa[/url] on Twitter for future updates.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement: December 14th!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We're happy to announce that Gorogoa will be available on Steam on December 14th! We'll share any additional news and updates regarding the release and afterwards here. Thanks for your interest and support in Gorogoa - it's almost here!

-Jeff
